'band joining each component costs at most 2(k-1)p' reads as if each of the two components costs 2(k-1)p. The intended and proved accounting (Proposition 6.2, Section 6.3) is (k-1)p per component, 2(k-1)p for the block and its mirror. Suggested wording: 'band joining the block and its mirror costs at most 2(k-1)p'. No mathematical change.
